doc: PROFILE.md §6.1: '`readers.i3s` and `readers.slpk` always present.' stages/readers.slpk.rst is new at 2.6.0 and its Options section names `filename` -- 'SLPK file must have a file extension of .slpk.' -- `obb` -- 'An oriented bounding box used to filter the data being retrieved.' -- `dimensions` -- 'Comma-separated list of dimensions that should be read.' -- and `min_density and max_density` -- 'This is the range of density of the points in the nodes that will be selected during the read.' Registering the stage is what makes `pdal --options readers.slpk` (apps/index.rst) print that table on stdout; at 2.5.0 the stage does not exist and stdout is empty. SLPK is the local-file sibling of `readers.i3s` -- the page's own words, 'a format that allows you to package all the necessary I3S files together and store them locally rather than find information through REST' -- so, unlike a read, its option table is deterministic and needs no network. Option NAMES only: the binary's one-line help strings are stated by no shipped page, so they are not graded (CASE_AUTHORING.md's rule against asserting undocumented message text). WHY THIS CASE AND `i3s-options` ARE NOT REDUNDANT EVEN THOUGH THE TWO TABLES COINCIDE: at 2.6.0 `pdal --options readers.slpk` and `pdal --options readers.i3s` print the same twelve names, because both stages derive from the same Esri reader base. What each case grades is the subset ITS OWN page documents, and those subsets differ -- `threads` is on `readers.i3s.rst` only and is deliberately NOT asserted here, while the `filename` this case grades is the one `readers.slpk.rst` defines, a local archive that 'must have a file extension of .slpk', not i3s's remote 'i3s://' URL. A candidate that registered only one of the two stages fails exactly one of the two cases, which is the independence the two cases exist for.
